title: Architecture: NexLab NYC Taxi Data Platform
description: Automated Lakehouse platform for 78M+ NYC taxi trip records using Apache Iceberg on MinIO, Spark processing, Airflow orchestration, Trino query engine, and bilingual Streamlit dashboard.

nodes.label: NYC TLC Parquet Files
nodes.description: 24 monthly Parquet files (2022-2023) with 78M+ records, ~10 GB compressed

nodes.label: Spark Ingestion
nodes.description: Reads individual Parquet files with unionByName for schema variation handling

nodes.label: MinIO Object Storage
nodes.description: S3-compatible storage for Iceberg table data and metadata

nodes.label: Apache Iceberg
nodes.description: Open table format with REST catalog, time travel, schema evolution, hidden partitioning

nodes.label: Bronze
nodes.description: Raw ingested taxi trip data (2 tables)

nodes.label: Silver
nodes.description: Cleansed and validated trip data with SHA-256 surrogate keys (2 tables)

nodes.label: Gold
nodes.description: Business-ready aggregates for revenue trends, zone performance, hourly demand (3 tables)

nodes.label: Spark Processing
nodes.description: 7 ETL jobs for Bronze/Silver/Gold transformations with structlog logging

nodes.label: Data Quality Framework
nodes.description: 18 quality checks (not_null, uniqueness, row_count, range) with PostgreSQL persistence

nodes.label: Trino 435
nodes.description: Fast interactive OLAP queries on Iceberg tables for dashboard serving

nodes.label: Apache Airflow
nodes.description: 7-task DAG: Bronze, Silver x2, Gold x3, DQ via SparkSubmitOperator

nodes.label: Streamlit Dashboard
nodes.description: Bilingual (EN/VI) interactive dashboard with Plotly charts for daily revenue, zone performance, hourly demand

nodes.label: FastAPI Metadata
nodes.description: REST API for ETL flags, DQ results, and pipeline audit logs

nodes.label: PostgreSQL Ops
nodes.description: Separate ops schema for ETL flags, DQ results, pipeline audit logs
